act_title: The State Bank of Sikkim (Acquisition of Shares) and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1982
title: In this Schedule, “shareholder” means any person who, immediately before the appointed day, is
text:
1. In this Schedule, “shareholder” means any person who, immediately before the appointed day, is

registered as the holder of a share in the Sikkim Bank, other than the State Government of Sikkim.
